verdict.rationale: The evidence shows programmatic control only of the Codex portion of the product: a Codex SDK for automating coding tasks, including in CI (chatgpt-docs-91), and a scriptable Codex CLI with flags like --cd and --search (chatgpt-docs-92, chatgpt-docs-36, chatgpt-docs-61). Nothing documents a public API for driving ChatGPT itself (chats, Work, automations), and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404 (chatgpt-probe-3). GPT custom actions call third-party APIs outbound, so they do not count as an API for driving the product. Missing for 10: a documented public API covering core ChatGPT/Work functionality, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, SDK depth beyond a single mention, and independent hands-on corroboration.
